subject: Renewal + Seat Expansion — procurement steps for Pivotal Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@pivotalhealth.com>, procurement@pivotalhealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-28T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + Seat Expansion — procurement steps for Pivotal Health

Hi Sarah / Pivotal procurement team,

Hope you had a good weekend. Pivotal's annual renewal is coming up on 2028-09-30 and the customer has confirmed they want to add 150 committed seats (capacity uplift) and shorten the primary term to a 12-month roll. To keep the renewal on track we need to align on the procurement path so finance can issue a PO by mid-September.

Attached is the updated quote (redwood_quote_PivotalHealth_v3.pdf) with line items for the committed seats and the pro-rated term. Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm whether your procurement portal (PO upload) or a standard emailed PO is preferred
- If portal: tell us the contact and any PO template/fields we should pre-fill
- If email: we will provide a PO template for Pivotal to sign and route

Can you also confirm whether payment terms (Net 30) remain or if we need to accommodate Net 45 for this renewal?

I'll loop in Jonas (account lead) and Marissa (CS) to help with the onboarding ramp schedule once PO is in.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that helps the handoff.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_quote_PivotalHealth_v3.pdf
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@pivotalhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, procurement@pivotalhealth.com
Date: 2028-08-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Seat Expansion — procurement steps for Pivotal Health

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the note and updated quote.

We plan to use our procurement portal for renewals and seat additions. I copied procurement@pivotalhealth.com for the upload gate. Can you pre-fill the PO template fields we usually require: vendor address, tax ID, invoice deliverable schedule, and the specific SKU/qty breakdown? Our portal also requires the customer BU approver email — I'll confirm that separately.

Net 30 is fine. We will aim to push the PO through the portal by 2028-09-12 provided we have the pre-filled document and the SOW.

Also: procurement asked for a signed SOW or acceptance email from Pivotal that references the quote.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Director, Vendor Operations
Pivotal Health

Kim / team — quick internal note on approvals and intake: 

1) Legal / Contracts (Aditya) — Pivotal asked for SOW acceptance language. Aditya, can you confirm if the standard SOW addendum we used for Helio is OK to reuse (same acceptance clause + pro-rated term)? If not, we need to turn around a short redline to procurement within 48 hours to hit Pivotal's PO timeline.
2) Finance — we'll prepare the pre-filled PO template (see PO_template_Redwood.xlsx) and include the vendor tax ID and invoice cadence.
3) CS / Onboarding (Marissa) — once PO is uploaded, please prioritize the ramp plan for an interim 30-day onboarding window for the first 50 seats, then weekly cadence for the remainder. Pivotal indicated an aggressive go-live in Q4.

I uploaded a draft quote and the PO template to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3PivotalRenewalDocs.

If Legal signs off on reusing the Helio SOW language we can get the DocuSign package out today.

— Jonas
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per our internal notes: 
- Net 30 confirmed
- We will pre-fill the portal fields you listed (vendor address, tax ID, invoice cadence, SKU/qty) and upload both the PO template and a short SOW acceptance statement for signature.

Next actions from Redwood: 
1) I attached the pre-filled PO template (PO_template_Redwood.xlsx) to this email for your procurement team to validate fields.
2) DocuSign: we prepared a one-page SOW acceptance that references quote redwood_quote_PivotalHealth_v3.pdf; link below when ready.
3) I'll schedule a 20-minute intake call with your procurement lead and our finance ops to confirm portal upload requirements — suggest 2028-09-05 or 2028-09-06 in the morning PT. Please let me know which works.

DocuSign (will be sent as soon as legal confirms language): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123xyz

Appreciate your help getting this into the portal. 

Best,
Kimberly

Thanks — team is aligned.

— Jonas
